notablePrerequisites:
Sword of the Paruns attached to Kibo.
Kibo does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Kibo by tapping them, causing each player to create a Banana artifact token.
Activate your Banana by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3} and gaining 2 life.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Kibo.
Repeat.
